# ffms2 / ffms2_fuzzer

OSS-Fuzz's fuzz target `ffms2_fuzzer` (source not in this release yet) over ffms2 (FFMS/ffms2 at 3af2ef2a).

Writes the input to /tmp/libfuzzer.<pid>, creates an indexer and indexes it (FFMS_IEH_ABORT), asks for the first video track; the index and track number are discarded and no frame is decoded.

## How this program differs from what OSS-Fuzz runs
- Linked against ffms2 at commit 3af2ef2a.
- In every build, getenv() returns NULL, getpid() returns 1 and mkstemp() uses a fixed name, so the program depends only on its input.
- A small driver reads the input file, calls the harness one to four times and prints each return value.
- The harness source was modified for these builds; the modified copy is not in this release yet.

## What the harness checks
The harness makes no check of its own beyond not crashing, so a statement about it says only that the code it calls never crashes, hangs or trips a sanitizer.

## Builds
Static riscv64 Linux programs, compiled for RV64G and run as `<file> <input-file>`; `oft fetch ffms2` downloads the published ones and checks each against its SHA-256.

| build | file | bytes | sha256 |
|---|---|---:|---|
